histologic_type.label: Histologic type
options: Small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma, high grade
Large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma, high grade

stromal_invasion_depth.label: Depth of stromal invasion
options: Greater than 3 mm but not more than 5 mm

stromal_invasion_extent.label: Extent of depth of stromal invasion

distance_to_margin.label: Distance from invasive carcinoma to closest margin

status.label: Regional lymph node status
options: Tumor present in pelvic lymph node(s)
Tumor present in para-aortic lymph node(s)

pT_category.label: pT category
options: pT not assigned (cannot be determined based on available pathological information)
pT0: No evidence of primary tumor
pT1: Carcinoma is strictly confined to the cervix (extension to the uterine corpus should be disregarded)
pT1a: Invasive carcinoma diagnosed only by microscopy, with maximum depth of invasion 5 mm or less
pT1a1: Measured stromal invasion 3 mm or less in depth
pT1a2: Measured stromal invasion greater than 3 mm and 5 mm or less in depth
pT1b: Invasive carcinoma with deepest invasion measured greater than 5 mm; lesion limited to the cervix uteri, size measured by the largest tumor diameter
pT1b1: Invasive carcinoma with depth of stromal invasion greater than 5 mm and greatest dimension 2 cm or less
pT1b2: Invasive carcinoma greater than 2 cm and 4 cm or less in greatest dimension
pT1b3: Invasive carcinoma greater than 4 cm in greatest dimension
pT2: Carcinoma invades beyond the uterus, but has not extended to the lower third of the vagina or to the pelvic wall
pT2a: Involvement limited to the upper two-thirds of the vagina without parametrial invasion
pT2a1: Invasive carcinoma 4 cm or less in greatest dimension
pT2a2: Invasive carcinoma greater than 4 cm in greatest dimension
pT2b: With parametrial invasion but not up to the pelvic wall
pT3: Carcinoma involves lower third of vagina and/or extends to pelvic wall and/or causes hydronephrosis or non-functioning kidney
pT3a: Carcinoma involves lower third of vagina, without extension to the pelvic wall
pT3b: Extension to pelvic wall and/or hydronephrosis or non-functioning kidney (unless known to be due to another cause)
pT4: Carcinoma has involved the mucosa of the bladder or rectum confirmed by biopsy, or has extended to adjacent organs

pN_category.label: pN category
options: pN not assigned (no nodes submitted or found)
pN not assigned (cannot be determined based on available pathological information)
pN0: No regional lymph node metastasis
pN0(i+): Isolated tumor cells in regional lymph node(s), 0.2 mm or less, or single cells or clusters not exceeding 200 cells in a single lymph node cross-section
pN1: Regional lymph node metastasis to pelvic lymph nodes only
pN1mi: Regional lymph node metastasis (greater than 0.2 mm but 2.0 mm or less) to pelvic lymph nodes
pN1a: Regional lymph node metastasis (diameter greater than 2.0 mm) to pelvic lymph nodes
pN2: Regional lymph node metastasis to para-aortic lymph nodes, with or without positive pelvic lymph nodes
pN2mi: Metastasis to para-aortic lymph nodes (greater than 0.2 mm but 2.0 mm or less), with or without positive pelvic lymph nodes
pN2a: Metastasis to para-aortic lymph nodes (diameter greater than 2.0 mm), with or without positive pelvic lymph nodes

pM_category.label: pM category
options: Not applicable - pM cannot be determined from the submitted specimen(s)
pM1: Distant metastasis (includes metastasis to inguinal lymph nodes, intraperitoneal disease, lung, liver, or bone; excludes metastasis to pelvic or para-aortic lymph nodes, or vagina)

figo_stage.label: FIGO stage
options: IA1: Invasive carcinoma diagnosed only by microscopy; stromal invasion 3 mm or less in depth
IA2: Invasive carcinoma diagnosed only by microscopy; stromal invasion greater than 3 mm and 5 mm or less in depth
IB1: Invasive carcinoma with deepest invasion greater than 5 mm (greater than IA); lesion limited to the cervix uteri; 2 cm or less in greatest dimension
IB2: Invasive carcinoma with deepest invasion greater than 5 mm (greater than IA); lesion limited to the cervix uteri; greater than 2 cm and 4 cm or less in greatest dimension
IB3: Invasive carcinoma with deepest invasion greater than 5 mm (greater than IA); lesion limited to the cervix uteri; greater than 4 cm in greatest dimension
IIA1: Carcinoma involving the upper two-thirds of the vagina without parametrial invasion; 4 cm or less in greatest dimension
IIA2: Carcinoma involving the upper two-thirds of the vagina without parametrial invasion; greater than 4 cm in greatest dimension
IIB: Carcinoma with parametrial invasion but not up to the pelvic wall
IIIA: Carcinoma involving the lower third of the vagina, without extension to the pelvic wall
IIIB: Carcinoma extending to the pelvic wall and/or causing hydronephrosis or non-functioning kidney (unless known to be due to another cause)
IIIC1: Pelvic lymph node metastasis only
IIIC2: Para-aortic lymph node metastasis, with or without pelvic lymph node metastasis
IVA: Carcinoma invading the mucosa of the bladder or rectum and/or extension beyond the true pelvis (bullous edema does not allow a case to be allotted to stage IVA)
IVB: Distant metastasis (including peritoneal spread or involvement of the supraclavicular, mediastinal or distant lymph nodes; lung; liver; or bone)
